verdict.rationale: Codegen docs explicitly describe an automated PR review flow (reads diff, summarizes changes, runs security/secrets scan, checks coverage, posts a review comment) and general 'review PRs, suggest changes, comment on issues' capability, supporting the core ask. However the evidence doesn't confirm true line-level inline comments on every PR, and other docs note the agent 'only responds to comments containing explicit mentions,' suggesting review may be conditional/triggered rather than fully automatic for every PR. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent confirmation of inline diff comments, explicit confirmation of always-on automatic triggering for every PR without mention-based gating.
